purpose: Original source-locator notes for canonical v2 storage, bounded endpoint permission and junction-graph assessment. These checks do not supply a general instance-conformance validator.

source.publication: The Open Group C260, ArchiMate 4 Specification, April 2026
source.method: Read-only text inspection with visual verification of relevant clauses, figures and table cells in the owner-provided PDF. PDF page numbers are one-based.
source.boundary: Original analysis and locators only. No source document, prose, figures or normative artwork redistributed. No conformance, certification, licence interpretation or endorsement is claimed. Independent-source CC BY declarations do not apply to this artifact.

locators.context: Model abstraction does not distinguish types from real-world instances.
Endpoint arity, relationship-to-relationship prohibition and restrictions involving junction or relationship endpoints.
Composition existence dependency and the distinction between modeled categories and their real-world instances.
Specialization orientation and same-type permission, without a same-type-only restriction.
Junction relationship-family, end-to-end permission and degree constraints; containing aggregation is treated separately.
Multiplicity concerns represented instances, with an exception for junction ends; it does not define counts of view drawings.
Metamodel specialization and model-level specialization are distinguished.
Specialization transitivity is a derivation rule, not an explicit acyclicity constraint.
Existing endpoint controls: Process to Function Specialization is forbidden; Artifact to DataObject Specialization has direct permission.
Separate concept-endpoint permissions, oriented junction ports and unresolved aggregation/composition junction scope; see docs/CONCEPT-ENDPOINTS.json.

interpretation_limit: The inspected material did not establish blanket self-link, cycle, unique composite owner or single specialization parent prohibitions. Canonical v2 stores typed concept endpoints and junctions. Its bounded junction constraints do not establish whole-model or general instance conformance.

scope: Topology and repeated drawings do not change ordinary-element type permission or imply instance-cardinality rules
Structurally valid typed endpoints and junctions are represented in core v2; malformed references still fail structurally
Bounded junction findings stay distinct from overall normative UNKNOWN
names: instance topology does not widen bounded endpoint assessment
repeated drawings do not count as additional model relationships
wrong-kind endpoint IDs, misplaced junction types and nesting fail structurally before assessment

preserved_contract.instance_topology: Parallel, self and cyclic references are structurally representable. Separate bounded junction findings are advisory, not a general instance ALLOWED/FORBIDDEN verdict.
preserved_contract.unsupported_representations: REFERENCE, TYPE and UNSUPPORTED exceptions remain structural boundaries, not normative FORBIDDEN verdicts. Unknown semantic queries remain UNKNOWN. V1 inner format/profile is rejected without conversion.
preserved_contract.multiplicity: Raw annotations do not impose instance or view-drawing counts. Any present junction-end attribute has separate applicability diagnostics; data is retained.
preserved_contract.source_unresolved_triples: Preserve exactly the eight Product/Plateau to Deliverable/WorkPackage Aggregation/Composition B.5 UNKNOWNs and their evidence.
preserved_contract.separate_junction_source_scope: Aggregation/Composition with any junction endpoint stays source-scope UNKNOWN; this does not increase or resolve the eight ordinary-element cases.
